goal: Run one 4h-class chain as bounded cages under this job_id: (1) blade launch+gate, (2) bootstrap, (3) drain batch, (4) receipt+knot. Prove the seat contract on grok+codex before any new seats. Disk is supervisor.
invariants: CHAIN OF BOUNDED CAGES under one durable job ID (salon 4/4).
Frozen spec at hour 0 — this directory. Chat is heat.
Checkpoint = atomic trail_core_N: completed, artifact hashes, test results, failures, budget elapsed, ONE next action, resume_command.
Handoff = next seat reads seat_contract.json + SPEC.md + last trail_core only, never the chat log.
Disk is the supervisor; no new process (law 11).
job_floor claim/verify = single-flight: one cage in flight per job.
resume_command is the whole driver interface (operator phone or existing seat).
Covenant: state/vast/covenant.json — blade_max_dph 0.12, lifetime 4h, floor as filed. Do not raise caps without operator word.
One-builds-one-verifies: no Claude/Mistral slot-in until this chain runs clean end-to-end.
forbidden_moves: treat chat or compaction as DNA
ping all frontiers on every prompt
leave a blade up with nobody watching (reap at lifetime)
start cage n+1 without trail_core_n on disk

cage_0: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path(r'jobs/first-4h-chain/SPEC.md'); assert p.is_file()"

.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "from pathlib import Path,json; c=json.load(open(r'jobs/first-4h-chain/seat_contract.json',encoding='utf-8')); t=Path(r'jobs/first-4h-chain/trail_core_0.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert c['resume_command'] in t"
cage_2_bootstrap: GET blade OpenAI-compat /v1/models after gate (tunnel or mapped port); smoke one chat
cage_4_receipt_knot: FILE receipt under jobs/first-4h-chain/ plus verkle/trail core; hashes in trail_core_4
